Pi for Antigravity

Unofficial Antigravity App / CLI plugin and local stdio MCP bridging Antigravity to your existing local pi CLI.

English · 简体中文

Offload multi-turn repo scans, multi-file edits, and test loops to faster or cheaper local `pi` models—trading a little latency to keep your main Antigravity model's context clean and save quota. - **`execute`** — delegate broad codebase search, multi-file edits/refactors, tests, and log analysis to `pi`. - **`review`** — optional, fresh, read-only code review of working-tree changes against a Git baseline (default `HEAD`) plus untracked files. The main agent keeps planning, coordination, native tools/Browser, and final judgment. ```text Antigravity → local stdio MCP → local pi CLI → your configured model provider ``` ## Requirements - **Node.js >= 22.19** - A working, authenticated local **`pi`** CLI (tested with `pi 1.5.2`). Verify `pi --version` and a normal prompt before installing. - **Git** for Git-based reviews (on Windows, Git for Windows also provides Git Bash for `pi`). ## Install ### Option 1: npm one-liner (Recommended — Antigravity App & CLI) ```bash npx -y pi-for-antigravity install ``` Installs a self-contained copy (`server.cjs`) pinned to your local Node executable into `~/.gemini/config/plugins/pi-for-antigravity/` (Windows: `%USERPROFILE%\.gemini\config\plugins\pi-for-antigravity\`) for fast startup and offline use. Supports `--config /abs/path/config.json` and `--target /abs/path/plugin-dir`. ### Option 2: Official Antigravity CLI (`agy`) ```bash agy plugin install https://github.com/shenjiecode/pi-for-antigravity ``` Installs directly from GitHub and launches the MCP server via `npx -y pi-for-antigravity@`. ### Option 3: GitHub Release ZIP (offline / no npm) Download `pi-for-antigravity-.zip` from [Releases](https://github.com/shenjiecode/pi-for-antigravity/releases), extract it, enter `pi-for-antigravity/`, and run: ```bash node ./install.cjs ``` Restart Antigravity App and check **Customizations → Installed**. Update by re-running the installer; personal config is preserved. Disable or uninstall via **Customizations → Installed** or `agy plugin disable|uninstall pi-for-antigravity`. ## Configuration In plugin mode, configuration and state live in the host-provided `PLUGIN_DATA` directory: - `${PLUGIN_DATA}/config.json` — auto-created on first MCP start from `config.example.json`; it works out of the box with your local `pi` default model. - `${PLUGIN_DATA}/state/` — session metadata and per-run logs (old runs >7d/50 and inactive sessions >30d/100 are pruned automatically). Find the active config path in MCP initialization instructions, startup stderr, or the `config_path` tool result field. Per role, `provider`, `model`, and `thinking` are optional: omit them (as `config.example.json` does) to run with your local `pi` default model. Setting `provider` also requires `model`. The snippet below is an explicit per-role override example: ```json { "pi": { "command": "pi" }, "stateDir": "./state", "roles": { "executor": { "provider": "zai-coding-cn", "model": "glm-5.3-flash", "thinking": "high" }, "reviewer": { "enabled": true, "provider": "zai-coding-cn", "model": "glm-5.4", "thinking": "high" } } } ``` - `pi.command`: command name, native executable, or `.js`/`.mjs`/`.cjs` entry. `pi.agentDir` optionally overrides `PI_CODING_AGENT_DIR`. - `roles.`: optional `provider`, `model`, `thinking` (`off` | `minimal` | `low` | `medium` | `high` | `xhigh` | `max`), and `prompt`. Set `"reviewer": { "enabled": false }` and reconnect MCP to hide `review`. - New calls reload config; resumed executor sessions keep their saved settings. - Config precedence: `--config` → `PI_FOR_ANTIGRAVITY_CONFIG` → `${PLUGIN_DATA}/config.json` → standalone default (`~/.config/pi-for-antigravity/config.json` on Linux/macOS; `%APPDATA%\pi-for-antigravity\config.json` on Windows; XDG overrides supported). Relative paths resolve from the config file's directory. - **Windows `pi` lookup**: checks `PATH`, `%USERPROFILE%\.pi\agent\bin`, `%APPDATA%\npm`, and Node's directory. Managed `pi-launcher.js` and npm `pi.cmd` shims launch their JS entry directly under Node without `cmd.exe`. ## Tools & scope | Tool | Args | Behavior | | --- | --- | --- | | `execute` | `prompt`, absolute `cwd`, optional `session_id` | Full builtin tools; concurrent sessions share `cwd` (same session rejects overlap). | | `review` | `prompt`, absolute `cwd`, optional `base_ref` | Fresh context; read-only tools (`read,grep,find,ls`); includes diff summary and untracked files. | - Both roles run `pi --print --no-extensions --no-mcp --no-skills --no-prompt-templates --no-themes` for an isolated runtime (provider-extension-only models are unsupported). - Long results truncate at 24,000 chars inline; full text is saved at `output_path`. - Antigravity registers the server as `pi-for-antigravity_pi` with eager loading and host background execution. In headless `agy`, allow tools explicitly via `--settings '{"permissions":{"allow":["mcp(pi-for-antigravity_pi/review)"]}}'`. - Scope limits: no bundled `pi`/SDK, no credential/account management, no workflow/retry loops, and no remote/WSL bridge. ## Standalone MCP & development Other stdio MCP clients can launch `npx -y pi-for-antigravity --config /abs/path/config.json` directly. ```bash npm ci npm run check # version sync + TypeScript check npm test # offline test suite npm run validate:agy # validate repo root and bundled plugin via agy CLI npm run package:plugin # build portable ZIP + SHA-256 npm run test:live -- --config /abs/path/config.json # calls real models ``` See [design](docs/design.md), [verification](docs/verification.md), [releasing](docs/releasing.md), and [contributing](CONTRIBUTING.md). Licensed under [MIT](LICENSE).
